methodology.relative_volume: Latest valid 5m volume divided by average previous 20 valid 5m volumes
methodology.buy: Price > EMA20 and VWAP + RSI 52-70 + relative volume >= 1.2x + near recent high + 15m bullish
methodology.sell: Price < EMA20 and VWAP + RSI 30-48 + relative volume >= 1.2x + near recent low + 15m bearish

data_quality: IST session filtering, actual-LTP extraction, chart/LTP cross-check and volume validation enabled.
